analysis: All supplied changes are Markdown (changelog.d/*.md and docs/architecture/hardware-support.md). No source code, entitlements or dependency pins are in this batch, so the described behavior is unverified and there are no concrete regressions. The threat model needs updates for the following areas. (1) GLM-5.3-Flash coordinator-connected serving (changelog glm53-native-prerequisites.md lines 14, 9) turns the encrypted SSD prefix store on by default for the pinned GLM identity; this falls under T-041/SEC-035, whose at-rest and TTFT-oracle analysis and key_unavailable handling were written for other models. It also adds a DEBUG-only DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE persistent cache key (line 21). The claim that release builds do not contain this path is unverified; if it leaked into release builds it would bypass the SE-rooted KEK. (2) The provider self-reports the new capability glm5_next_v1 and chip/memory (line 14); this is a T-055 and TB-002 self-report concern, and the coordinator-side gating is not visible here. (3) Inline data:video/mp4 and quicktime parts are now decoded (ec6d770b4c2f6bdf, line 3). Decoding untrusted consumer media runs in the provider process (TB-007). T-050 covers plaintext video exposure via temp files, and the supplied text does not show whether the new path avoids temp files. The 512 MiB frame cap and 28,532-token cap are stated, but the implementation is not supplied. (4) Weight integrity hashing moves to F_NOCACHE page-aligned reads (line 23), claiming unchanged digests; relevant to T-012/T-027, but not verifiable. (5) hardware-support.md lines 35-42 openly state that the SDK response-object store has no eviction and that in-flight copies sit outside the LRU cap. This is a documented local-mode host-memory availability limit, not a trust-boundary change. (6) GLM MTP verification is not token-identical to target-only decoding (line 12), which touches T-007/T-056 correctness claims. The next pass should inspect the GLM media/video decoder, the prefix-cache key sourcing, and capability reporting once code is available.
